_about: W04 hand-verified layouts (offsets read in the 2016 WM; names pdb2017)

0x200d.name: NC_ACT_SOMEONEWHISPER_CMD
fields: bit0 GMColor = sender bIsGM; bits 1-7 stale
0x200d.notes: size 0x17 + len + count·0x67. Also sent by Spam_AlertGMs FUN_00432bb0 (gold-spammer alert to GMs) with itemLinkDataCount unwritten (W04-B54), talker = reported character, content = SpamerReport.shn SR_Message

0x200e.name: NC_ACT_WHISPERFAIL_ACK
fields: 0x0F69 not found, 0x0F6A prison (sender or receiver), 0x0F6B too long (client ignores), 0x0F6C receiver in GT arena

0x2010.name: NC_ACT_NOTICE_REQ
0x2010.notes: client sender needs adminlevel 100 and no prison

0x2011.name: NC_ACT_NOTICE_CMD
0x2011.notes: broadcast raw to every client session

0x2016.name: NC_ACT_PARTYCHAT_ACK
fields: 0x07C0 ok, 0x07C1 not in party, 0x07C2 too long

0xa802.name: NC_CHAT_RESTRICT_LIST_CMD
fields: 0x16 each: Name5 sCharID, u8 bIsGM, u8 bIsDeleted

0xa806.name: NC_CHAT_RESTRICT_ADD_ACK
fields: 0x1C00 ok, 0x1C01 prisoner, 0x1C02 self, 0x1C03 listed or full, 0x1C05…0x1C0A from the DB

0xa80a.name: NC_CHAT_RESTRICT_DEL_ACK
fields: 0x1C10 ok, 0x1C11 not in the list, 0x1C12 charNo not in the list, 0x1C13…0x1C16 DB

0xd002.name: NC_EVENT_GET_ALL_EVENT_INFO_ACK

0xd00a.name: NC_EVENT_SET_ALL_READY_ACK
